summary: Induction on n. For n = 0 no term satisfies CharsAgree (it would have a level < 0), so all blocks vanish. For n+1, split T into the terms of level n and the rest; the first part is bounded by energy_le_of_level_pairs with R = ∅ (link energy 0), the second by the induction hypothesis, and energy_add_le with ε = 1 combines them.

steps.claim: Induction on n (upward on Fin (ϱ+2)), for all stable T.
steps.lean:
induction' n using induction with j ih generalizing T
  · simp [energy, amplitudeSum_eq_zero_of_not_charsAgree hT (by grind)]; positivity

steps.claim: n = 0: no γ ∈ T satisfies CharsAgree, so every block of A_T vanishes and the energy is 0 ≤ C/b³⁰/4^{ϱ+1}.

Step n → n+1 (with induction hypothesis ih for all stable T): split A_T = A_{T∖L} + A_{T∩L}, L = {level n}; energy(A + B) ≤ 2·energy(A) + 2·energy(B); the part off level n by ih, the part of level n by energy_le_of_level_pairs with R = ∅ (its link energy is 0 ≤ w·ν² with w = 0).
steps.lean:
grw [amplitudeSum_split _ {γ | S.HasLevel j.castSucc γ}, energy_add_le one_pos, ih,
    energy_le_of_level_pairs hC _ _ hx _ le_rfl _ j.castSucc ∅ (h := by simp [linkEnergy])]

steps.claim: 2·C/b³⁰/4^{ϱ+1−n} + 2·C/b³⁰/4^{ϱ+1−n} = C/b³⁰/4^{ϱ−n} (rev of castSucc); stability of the two parts.
steps.lean: simp [rev_castSucc, pow_succ, field]; all_goals grind [IsStable, S.isStable_hasLevel j.castSucc]
